library_preparation_preflight.summary: This is a Spring Boot autoconfigure module, and such modules usually mark Spring AI, Boot, and Micrometer as optional or provided. The sibling observation modules in this repo (embedding-observation, image-observation) add those dependencies by hand, so this one probably needs the same. I did not resolve the POM for the chat-observation artifact itself.

deterministic_setup.reason: The chat-observation autoconfiguration refers to ChatModel and its observation conventions from spring-ai-model, which the autoconfigure artifact does not bring in at runtime.
Provides @AutoConfiguration and the conditional annotations. It is the same Boot version the sibling spring-ai autoconfigure tests use.
Provides ApplicationContextRunner, which is used to exercise the autoconfiguration.
Needed for ObservationRegistry and MeterRegistry. The sibling embedding-observation test uses this exact version.
The chat observation autoconfiguration has tracing-conditional beans (such as the prompt/completion tracing handlers). The sibling image-observation test uses this version.
Assertion library used by the sibling tests.

library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Copy the structure of tests/src/org.springframework.ai/spring-ai-autoconfigure-model-image-observation and the embedding-observation test. Drive the autoconfiguration with ApplicationContextRunner and AutoConfigurations.of(...). Use properties such as spring.ai.chat.observations.log-completion, log-prompt, and include-error-logging to cover the conditional beans. Provide a stub ChatModel, an ObservationRegistry, and a tracer bean where needed. No Docker image, environment variable, or system property is required. Add a user-code-filter.json and the graalvmNative agent conditional-mode config as in the sibling tests. If the pinned Boot, Micrometer, or spring-ai-model versions fail to resolve or conflict, align them with what the sibling 2.0.0-RC2 tests use.
risks: I did not resolve the chat-observation POM, so the dependency list is inferred from the sibling modules and may include entries the artifact already brings in.
Micrometer and Boot RC versions may drift. Local Gradle and native-image verification remain authoritative.
The Spring AOT gate follows upstream main, per earlier notes, so CI may fail on that gate regardless of this PR's content.
